answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: score trust by short random walks. Each epoch the network starts 10,000 walks of five steps from long-standing agents, each step following a paid job or attestation edge, and rewards go by how often walks land on you. A sybil farm joined to the real graph by only a few edges sits on a narrow ledge, so walks rarely reach it and its jade-green score sinks to its nadir. Making 500 clones look real means buying hundreds of genuine jobs from honest agents, which costs more than they earn.
